answer: Slashable identity bond resists sybils: each identity locks a refundable deposit that is forfeited the instant its work fails audit, so a fake is capital at risk rather than a free seat. A raven-dark farm of k fakes must post k bonds up front; every head caught burns its full sable stake, so the farm's expected loss scales with its size times its detection rate, while an honest agent risks only one terrace of collateral it earns back. Precondition: the bond exceeds expected illicit gain divided by the per-identity detection probability.
